}}{{Rebirth|image1=Droiddex Main.png|status=In-game|title1=Droiddex}}The '''Droidex''' is a database that contains all droids of every rarity. Each time a new droid is crafted, the database is automatically updated. You can access the Droidex through the Droidex computer, located next to the Daily Task Board in the players base. For each droid, the Droidex provides the following information:
*The droids class.
*The number of times that specific droid has been crafted.
*The droids companion ability.
Registering 25 different droids in the droiddex rewards the player with a 30% credit multiplier.

The droidex also tracks all droids that have the flawless paint. Collecting 51 unique flawless droids will reward the player with a credits multiplier.
